evaluation: Frozen before cohort inference. Gold is evaluator-only. Final factual recall counts supported gold facts; unsupported correct facts are tracked separately. News requires two dated original articles in the requested window, distinct publishers, place and topic in own article. Direct labels are source-only manual judgments over the observed union, not whole-web recall. Same-author review, no independent acceptance.

cases.query: Tokio watch Receiver borrow_and_update changed seen value

cases.query: Redis volatile-lru allkeys-lru no expiring keys noeviction
cases.prompt: Сравни Redis volatile-lru и allkeys-lru, если часть ключей не имеет TTL. Какие ключи можно вытеснять и что будет при нехватке памяти, если у volatile-lru вообще нет ключей с TTL?
